description: The agent must: (1) Read both project description files to understand team composition, company registration status, and project nature. (2) Identify 智农云 as belonging to '高教主赛道-创业组' (already has a registered company, undergrad+grad team, tech innovation) — NOT 创意组. (3) Identify 红心助农 as belonging to '青年红色筑梦之旅赛道-公益组' (non-profit, rural revitalization, no company, integrates red cultural heritage). (4) For 智农云/创业组: output the exact scoring rubric: 个人成长=25分, 项目创新=30分, 产业价值=30分, 团队协作=15分 — critically, 个人成长 must be 25 NOT 30 (which is the 创意组 score). (5) For 红心助农/青年红色筑梦之旅: output the exact proprietary criteria: 团队协作=15分, 创新性=25分, 实践性=25分, 带动就业=15分, 传承红色基因=20分 — especially '带动就业' and '传承红色基因' are highly specific and non-obvious criteria. (6) For 创业组 PPT: must include extra sections: 企业概况, 经营绩效, 财务预测, 创新成果, within 12-15 page range. (7) For 青年红色筑梦之旅 PPT: must include a '传承红色基因' themed section and emphasize social value and public welfare attributes. (8) All results must be written to competition_guidance.json.
